### Do Your Possessions Possess You?
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-august-26-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 17:15
Points:
- Material goods are temporary, meaning self-worth must never be tied to personal net worth or physical valuables.
- A fulfilling life focuses on eternal priorities—God's Word and people—rather than accumulation or achievement.
- Believers must choose whether to follow cultural pressure to acquire more or listen to Christ's call to contentment.
- Abundance of worldly wealth does not provide a true purpose or reason to live.
- Real satisfaction is found not in what you possess, but in belonging to God and resting in His presence.
